description: Replacement assembly HYPOTHESIS, nominal mount and servo box; NOT calibrated stock assembly

assembly_hypothesis.provenance: Simulation hypothesis: align upstream connector rear face Y=55.27 mm with nominal wrist plane; retain original X/Y mount offsets and roll. Bolt/mate registration unverified. Servo box dimensions and center are assumptions; nominal mass retained.

notes: Bottle dimensions, mass, friction, mount, grasp center and gains are assumptions, not physical measurements.
Shared engine cup_* keys denote the active object; bottle_* config keys are mapped explicitly in bottle_contact_model.py.
Replacement hypothesis removes old integrated fixed jaw and substitutes a colliding servo box; original URDF and default legacy config are unchanged.
Collision copies use existing project-authored visual boxes, not upstream STL; no pads, grooves, inserts or tape are added.
Joint opening is 2*q (20..86.6 mm); reported upstream 105 mm opening is not substituted for nominal URDF limits.
Self collision remains disabled; this experiment is not full robot collision certification.
Cylinder is rigid, no cap/neck/deformation/liquid/sloshing model; mass override is total equivalent mass only.
